question: HR-332 (nen/contract.json precedence, ROSTER OPEN-6): the contract lists which text wins when two disagree. Where does a text NOT on that list rank?

options.label: Loses to the list (Recommended)
options.consequence: Confirm the reading: an unlisted text yields to every listed one, and the conflict is filed as an issue to fix the unlisted text

options.label: Give it a rank
options.consequence: Amend: add the unlisted texts to the list at a named position
